release.content: pubtest 0.3.0 was released on 2026-11-20 from commit 127342c07c375c66ece0a75715c4ce8019a35547 with these changes.

rows: Record and replay for calls through integrations' Caller: a cassette per scenario (pubtest.cassettes, @sustenaut/pubtest/cassettes), on when integrations is installed and pubrules.json sets "pubtest": {"cassettes": ...} (a "DIR" only for a suite whose record transport is a stand-in: recording the real network into one warns); programs a scenario runs replay from it and report the calls they used; the pubtest record command (--all, --changed, scenarios, --rename, --create-data-repo) in both packages; failure steps on integrations' Faulty (can't be reached, does not answer in time, answers "M P" with N and:, answers with N then as recorded, answers with what is not JSON), the cassette of "SCENARIO" and @cassette:, the Caller slept N seconds, "NAME" was called N times; test customers (pubtest.customers entry points, register(api, { customers })); the pubtest[integrations] extra and an optional @sustenaut/integrations peer
the answers recorded in DIR and every recorded answer was used are gone: record cassettes with pubtest record
